race.comment: POCKET PYRO (13) has the most appealing profile after placing at both starts and she looks ready to peak third-up. She was beaten three and a half lengths as a dominant odds-on favourite at Balaklava, so the market expected more, but her debut third had substance and she has already beaten NEVER PEGASUS in a recent clash. NEVER PEGASUS (15) has been close in two of four starts, including a long-neck second as favourite at Penola on soft ground, and he has already placed at this track and distance. ASHEN GLOW (1) is the seasoned runner in the quartet, comes here third-up off a solid fourth at Strathalbyn, and the apprentice claim helps offset a modest winning record. GRAND MILLESIME (9) made progress last time out, finishing second at the end of 1200m at Halidon. Meets some better types this time but she can contest for a place.
